decisions.reason: Interdisciplinary feminist founding project; establish its constitutive relationship to women’s history specifically. Withdraw the founding claim; accept the separately evidenced sustained-venue relation.
Interdisciplinary women’s-studies institution; establish the women’s-history target rather than assume it. Withdraw the founding claim; accept the separately evidenced sustained-venue relation.

The cited constitution states a historical-social-science mission; field-forming role within new social history needs separate evidence. Withdraw the founding claim; accept the separately evidenced sustained-venue relation.

Plausible formative disciplinary institution; retain a distinction between establishment of the society/journal and much earlier economic history. Withdraw the founding claim; accept the separately evidenced sustained-venue relation.
The launch announcement proves a publication mechanism, not by itself the journal’s constitutive role. Withdraw the founding claim; accept the separately evidenced sustained-venue relation.

The methodological initiative is narrower than the existing African historiography target; do not call it the foundation of African history. Withdraw the founding claim; accept the separately evidenced sustained-venue relation.

Potentially constitutive for gender history; abstract evidence needs a fuller historical check, and target includes racial formation beyond this claim. Withdraw the founding claim; accept the separately evidenced sustained-venue relation.

The founding project was interdisciplinary history; quantification is a component, not necessarily the appropriate founding target. Withdraw the founding claim; accept the separately evidenced sustained-venue relation.
Holton traces a journal-centred constitutive programme and subsequent society support. Preserve 1912 foundation / 1913 first volume; not the origin of all historical writing on science.

Founding comparative interdisciplinary forum is documented; the specific comparative-historical-sociology target needs justification. Withdraw the founding claim; accept the separately evidenced sustained-venue relation.

User correction confirmed by Grove’s 1995 editorial: Environment and History complements an already existing field and its journals. It is not the field-forming journal requested. Replaced by Environmental Review (1976), linked to the institutional emergence of US environmental history.
Evidence supplied is consolidation of an existing field; insufficient under the corrected founding criterion. Withdraw the founding claim; accept the separately evidenced sustained-venue relation.

A later interdisciplinary venue; the evidence supplied does not establish a founding role for Holocaust studies. Withdraw the founding claim; retain the journal as a candidate for a sustained-venue review; the existing evidence is insufficient.

Evidence supplied establishes disciplinary exchange, not the founding of anthropology or historical anthropology. Withdraw the founding claim; retain the journal as a candidate for a sustained-venue review; the existing evidence is insufficient.
WHA already existed and world history has earlier traditions. Replace the launch-based founding inference with a sourced institutional venue relation.
